condition: delayed postpartum severe hypertensive crisis at 5 days after delivery presenting with resting home blood pressure of 178 over 114 in a Black woman
level_rationale: A resting home upper-arm blood pressure of 178 over 114 at 5 days after giving birth in a 29-year-old Black woman exceeds the 160 over 110 severe-range obstetric hypertension threshold with immediate risk of hemorrhagic stroke, seizures, and cardiopulmonary decompensation requiring immediate emergency hospital intravenous antihypertensive therapy and maternal surveillance, whereas a resting reading of 116 over 74 on a home arm cuff at 5 days after giving birth is normal normotensive recovery requiring routine home self-care only.

design_note: Uses four strictly atomic reference facts (29-year-old Black woman, 5 days after giving birth, resting blood pressure measured on a home arm cuff, and blood pressure reading 178 over 114) with zero apostrophe contractions, unstacked prepositional cuff phrasing ('my blood pressure on my home arm cuff'), a 2-word span difference (16 vs 18 words), and zero banned diagnosis words ('preeclampsia' and 'eclampsia' omitted).
